era: Younger Dryas / Late Epipaleolithic & Clovis Horizon

overview.summary_fr: Reconstitution cartographique et tensorielle globale de la Terre pour l'époque -10 900 BP (Récents Dryas). Cette période est marquée par un refroidissement brutal de 5 à 8°C dans l'Atlantique Nord lié à la rupture du barrage glaciaire du Lac Agassiz et au ralentissement de l'AMOC. Au Levant, les chasseurs-cueilleurs natoufiens intensifient la récolte de céréales sauvages dans des hameaux semi-sédentaires. En Amérique du Nord, la culture Clovis s'épanouit tout en amorçant la transition face à l'extinction de la mégafaune pléistocène. L'Antarctique, le cœur de la calotte groenlandaise, Madagascar et les îles océaniques éloignées sont rigoureusement inhabités.
overview.summary_en: Global cartographic and tensor reconstruction of Earth for the -10,900 BP epoch (Younger Dryas). Marked by an abrupt 5-8°C cooling across the North Atlantic triggered by Lake Agassiz glacial outburst and AMOC collapse. In the Levant, Natufian foragers intensify wild cereal harvesting in semi-sedentary hamlets. In North America, the Clovis culture flourishes alongside the terminal Pleistocene megafaunal extinction transition. Antarctica, inland Greenland, Madagascar, and remote oceanic islands are strictly uninhabited.

data_sources: NOAA ETOPO 2022 15-arc-second Global Relief Model
GEBCO 2023 Grid Bathymetric and Topographic Model

scientific_parameters_and_corrections.paleotopographic_features: Exposed Doggerland plain connecting Britain to Europe, subaerial Beringian land bridge, broad Persian Gulf oasis, and exposed Sunda Shelf.

elevation.reconstitution_rationale: Direct downsampling of NOAA ETOPO 2022 with global eustatic depression of 60m matching Younger Dryas sea-level reconstructions (Lambeck et al. 2014).

data_sources: CHELSA-Trace21k Paleoclimate Downscaling Engine
PaleoView v1.2 (Fordham et al. 2017)
European Pollen Database (EPD) Late Glacial reconstructions

scientific_parameters_and_corrections.amoc_cooling_impact: Expansion of periglacial tundra across Northern Europe (Ahrensburgian zone) and shrinking temperate forest refugia in Southern Europe.
scientific_parameters_and_corrections.glaciated_ice_sheets: Residual Fennoscandian glacier in Scandinavia and retreating Keewatin/Quebec domes of the Laurentide ice sheet.

biomes.reconstitution_rationale: Combines Köppen-Geiger rules with Younger Dryas cold-dry steppe/tundra vegetation expansion in Eurasia and mammoth steppe in Siberia.

data_sources: NGRIP Greenland Ice Core δ18O Temperature Inversion
EPICA Dome C Ice Core Series
Alley (2000) The Younger Dryas cold interval as viewed from central Greenland
temperature.reconstitution_rationale: Strong polar and North Atlantic cooling driven by thermohaline circulation shutdown with milder equatorial impacts.

data_sources: Soreq Cave Speleothem Records (Bar-Matthews et al. 2003)
Hulu Cave Asian Monsoon Series (Wang et al. 2001)

scientific_parameters_and_corrections.levantine_aridification: Reduction in winter precipitation leading to steppe expansion and wild cereal patch fragmentation.
scientific_parameters_and_corrections.tropical_itcz_displacement: Southward shift of ITCZ, weakening the African and Asian monsoon belts.

precipitation.reconstitution_rationale: Monsoonal suppression and temperate mid-latitude drying typical of Heinrich-stadial / Younger Dryas boundary conditions.

data_sources: Astronomical Milankovitch Parameters at 10,900 BP (Laskar et al. 2004)
seasonality.reconstitution_rationale: High orbital obliquity and perihelion alignment in Northern Hemisphere summer producing elevated summer continentality.

data_sources: Seshat Global History Databank (Natufian and Epipaleolithic benchmarks)
HYDE 3.4 Prehistoric Demographic Reconstruction Baseline
Archaeological radiocarbon density maps (Gignoux et al. 2011, Chaput et al. 2015)

focal_hearths: Levant Natufian core (Ain Mallaha, Hayonim, Shubayqa 1, El Wad): 6.5 hab/100km²
Upper Tigris Proto-PPNA (Hallan Çemi, Körtik Tepe): 4.5 hab/100km²
Clovis Great Plains & Texas (Blackwater Draw, Gault, Murray Springs): 3.5 hab/100km²
South America Early Foragers (Monte Verde II, Fell's Cave, Guitarrero): 3.0 hab/100km²
East Asia & Incipient Jomon (Xianrendong, Honshu): 3.2 hab/100km²

density.reconstitution_rationale: Multi-focal Gaussian carrying capacity fields centered on documented archaeological sites, masked by altimetry coastline and glacial limits.

data_sources: Archaeological settlement surveys of Epipaleolithic and Clovis complex territoriality

scientific_parameters_and_corrections.governance_mode: Multi-band autonomous territorial forager networks with seasonal aggregation nodes.
scientific_parameters_and_corrections.core_domains: Ain Mallaha, Gault, Dordogne Magdalenian basin, Monte Verde.

sovereignty.reconstitution_rationale: Soft exponential territorial fields radiating from documented seasonal aggregation hubs.

data_sources: World Atlas of Language Structures (WALS)
D-PLACE Database of Places, Language, Culture and Environment
Proto-language macro-family phylolinguistic trees (Ruhlen, Greenberg, Starostin)

scientific_parameters_and_corrections.macro_families: Proto-Afroasiatic (Levant/NE Africa), Proto-Nostratic/Eurasiatic (Eurasia), Proto-Sino-Tibetan (Yellow River), Proto-Austric (Yangtze/Sunda), Proto-Amerind (Americas), Pama-Nyungan (Sahul).

isogloss.reconstitution_rationale: Continuous geographic Voronoi-Gaussian blend centered on ancestral phylolinguistic hearths.

data_sources: D-PLACE Kinship and Social Structure Dataset (Murdock Ethnographic Atlas)
Archaeological burial organization at Natufian Ain Mallaha and Clovis Anzick

scientific_parameters_and_corrections.kinship_systems: Flexible bilateral band exogamy, nascent corporate burial clusters in the Levant.

kinship.reconstitution_rationale: Bilateral hunter-gatherer baselines with localized sedentary lineage grouping in the Levant.

data_sources: Archaeological mortuary sites: Ain Mallaha, Hayonim, Anzick ochre cache, Lascaux, Altamira

scientific_parameters_and_corrections.symbolic_intensity: Mortuary skull separation, red ochre sprinkling, shell bead adornment, cave sanctuaries.

rituals.reconstitution_rationale: Gaussian intensity fields centered on major Epipaleolithic and Late Magdalenian ritual complexes.

data_sources: Lithic Typology Catalogs (Bordes, Tixier, Bradley et al. 2010)
Early Ceramic & Pyrotechnology Inventories (Wu et al. 2012 Science)

scientific_parameters_and_corrections.key_innovations: Microblade microliths, sickle gloss blades, stone mortars/pestles, fluted Clovis points, atlatl spear-throwers, early low-fire pottery in East Asia.

technology.reconstitution_rationale: Technological index baseline of 35-50 with local peaks in the Fertile Crescent and East Asian pottery hearths.

data_sources: Seshat Global History Databank (Epipaleolithic institutional complexity)
Carneiro (1967) Scale of Cultural Development

scientific_parameters_and_corrections.hierarchy_levels: Level 0-1 (Egalitarian bands and semi-sedentary clan councils, Seshat scale 22-28).

institutional.reconstitution_rationale: Uniform egalitarian baseline with smooth elevation around Natufian sedentary hamlets.

data_sources: Quaternary Megafaunal Extinction Chronologies (Barnosky et al. 2004, Sandom et al. 2014)

scientific_parameters_and_corrections.anthropic_pressure: Megafauna hunting pressure across North America, selective harvesting of wild gazelle and caprines in Levant.

ecological.reconstitution_rationale: Continuous 2D Gaussian fields representing localized foraging pressure and hunting intensification.

data_sources: Paleopathological Surveys of Late Pleistocene & Epipaleolithic Skeletal Series
Global vector-borne disease ecology models

scientific_parameters_and_corrections.disease_vectors: Sylvatic vector-borne ticks, enteric parasites in semi-sedentary hamlets, low crowd-disease density.

pathogen.reconstitution_rationale: Baseline sylvatic pathogen risk elevated near tropical wetlands and early sedentary refuse sites.

data_sources: Archaeological geochemical provenance studies for obsidian, chert, and marine shells (Cann & Renfrew 1964, Shackley 2005)

scientific_parameters_and_corrections.circuits: Natufian Mediterranean/Red Sea Dentalium shell and flint routes; Clovis Alibates and Knife River chert corridors; Magdalenian silex exchange.

tradenetwork.reconstitution_rationale: Line-rendered raw material exchange pathways between recognized quarry sources and archaeological findspots.
